argv:
set -u; CL=$1; R=$2; B=$(printf "\x60"); rm -rf "$R"; mkdir -p "$R/corpus/knowledge" "$R/corpus/lessons"; printf "EXPECTED
" >"$R/corpus/ok.txt"; for f in AGENTS.md LOG.md PROVINCE.md SCORECARD.md SHONEN.md SKILL.md; do printf "EXPECTED
" >"$R/$f"; done; printf "EXPECTED
" >"$R/corpus/README.md"; SHA=$(sha256sum "$R/corpus/ok.txt" | cut -d" " -f1); printf "corpus/ok.txt	%s	1	9
" "$SHA" >"$R/stamps.tsv"; printf "R1-01	grep -c EXPECTED corpus/ok.txt	^1\$	0	5	coldread
" >"$R/claims-r.tsv"; six() { local f=$1; shift; { printf "## Round 1 — pre-move

| Axis | Score | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
"; for ax in depth coverage operability freshness calibration adjacency; do printf "| %s | 7 | %s |
" "$ax" "$1"; shift; done; } >"$f"; }; P="${B}corpus/ok.txt${B}"; I="${B}R1-01${B}"; six "$R/sc-ok.md" "$P" "$I" "$I" "$I" "$I" "$I"; six "$R/sc-vacuous.md" "$P" "$P" "$P" "$P" "$P" "$P"; printf "# scorecard with no round tables at all
" >"$R/sc-empty.md"; for sc in sc-ok sc-empty sc-vacuous; do out=$(bash "$CL" cells --root "$R" --claims "$R/claims-r.tsv" --stamps "$R/stamps.tsv" --scorecard "$R/$sc.md" --docs "$R/$sc.md" 2>&1); e=$?; echo "== cells --scorecard $sc.md exit=$e"; printf "%s
" "$out" | tail -n 2 | cut -c1-200; done
